name: check_key
description: Check a provider API key with one free call to the provider. Returns ok, the default model and whether it is still available. Makes no billed call.

output.description: JSON object {provider, ok, default_model, default_model_ok, detail}. Some providers add optional fields: default_model_verified (false when a restricted key can't confirm the model is still available), music (elevenlabs: whether the account's plan includes music), and per-capability *_model_ok flags (gemini: image_model_ok, tts_model_ok, music_model_ok).
